definitions.explanation: A part of text, data, or content being accidentally left out or missing. Used for errors in documents, printed materials, or data sets.
Leaving or falling behind from a group, competition, race, or course of study. Implies being unable to keep up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数行|すうぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Several missing lines were found in the manuscript.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check whether there is any missing data.

examples.japanese: レース⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I dropped out of the race.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people drop out along the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられ→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ず、⟦{半数|はんすう}→半数：30503_hansuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Unable to endure the harsh training, half of them dropped out.

notes:
Composed of {脱|だつ} (escape, remove) and {落|らく} (fall, drop). The word conveys the idea of something falling away from where it should be, whether text from a document or a person from a group.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脱落|だつらく}: missing character
- {脱落|だつらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop out, to be omitted
- レース⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{脱落|だつらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop out of a race
- {脱落|だつらく}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: dropout; person who falls behind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{欠落|けつらく}→欠落：21121_ketsuraku⟧: missing, lacking — emphasizes something being absent that should be present; often used for qualities or elements
- ⟦{脱字|だつじ}→脱字：16583_datsuji⟧: omitted character — specifically a missing character in text (narrower than {脱落|だつらく})
- リタイア: retire/withdraw — the loanword for dropping out of a race or competition, more casual
